info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Vesuvian Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the addition of detailed information for the Vesuvian Jacket within the product catalog. By enabling users to submit comprehensive data, businesses enhance their inventory management and customer awareness. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, retail management systems, and product information managers looking to streamline catalog updates. The endpoint supports operations that ensure the availability of accurate and detailed product descriptions, improving overall user engagement and sales potential.

post.summary: Submit details for the Vesuvian Jacket.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit detailed information about the Vesuvian Jacket, including specifications and features. It is ideal for users who want to provide comprehensive data for the product, ensuring accurate representation in our database.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Vesuvian jacket. It should contain all necessary information in JSON format to create or update the jacket's details in the system.

200.description: Request completed successfully; details of the Vesuvian jacket returned.
